fang_bounty.name: Fang Bounty
fang_bounty.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Fang Bounty. Collect four gnoll fangs and trade them to Warden Holt.
fang_bounty.complete_text: Four fangs, and not a bite on you. Good work, {name}. Here's your bounty. The watch pays for every four you bring.
fang_bounty.first_complete_text: Take this blade as well. It served me before I earned a better one. May it serve you as well.
fang_bounty.ready_text: Those look like gnoll fangs you're carrying, {name}. Hand them over.

trail_pack_cord.name: A Proper Pack (1 of 3)
trail_pack_cord.accept_text: You have taken on a task: A Proper Pack. Bring Tovin four rat whiskers.
trail_pack_cord.ready_text: Whiskers! Four of them? Hand them here, {name}.
trail_pack_cord.complete_text: Watch this. Twist, twist, and... there. Whisker cord, stronger than any thread in Emberhold.
trail_pack_cord.first_complete_text: Now the hide. Warden Holt's men have been culling the Blackpaw gnolls out past the gate, and a Blackpaw pelt cures into the best leather there is. Take this cord to Holt and ask him about [Tovin]. He'll know what to do.

trail_pack_hide.name: A Proper Pack (2 of 3)
trail_pack_hide.accept_text: You have taken on a task: A Proper Pack. Bring Warden Holt the whisker cord and two Blackpaw pelts.
trail_pack_hide.ready_text: That's Tovin's cord, and good pelts with it. Let's have them, {name}.
trail_pack_hide.complete_text: Hold still... there. Cured, cut and stitched with Tovin's cord. The watch owes that old haggler a favor anyway.
trail_pack_hide.first_complete_text: Take it back to Tovin. Tell him the watch wants a pack of its own next.

trail_pack_clasp.name: A Proper Pack (3 of 3)
trail_pack_clasp.accept_text: You have taken on a task: A Proper Pack. Bring Tovin the stitched hide and two fire beetle eyes for the clasp.
trail_pack_clasp.ready_text: Holt stitched it? And you've found the eyes! Give them over, {name}.
trail_pack_clasp.complete_text: A fire beetle's eye stays warm long after the beetle doesn't. Set in the clasp, it keeps the damp out of everything you carry.
trail_pack_clasp.first_complete_text: Here. A proper pack, the only one of its kind. Don't let the gnolls have it back.

thinning_the_pack.name: Thinning the Pack
thinning_the_pack.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Thinning the Pack. Bring Elowen four wolf pelts.
thinning_the_pack.ready_text: Pelts! You've been busy, {name}. Hand them here.
thinning_the_pack.complete_text: Good, clean pelts. The pack will think twice before coming near the road. Here's your coin.
thinning_the_pack.first_complete_text: And these. Wolfhide, stitched with thornback silk. They'll keep your feet quiet in the woods.

silk_and_venom.name: Silk and Venom
silk_and_venom.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Silk and Venom. Bring Elowen three lengths of spider silk and a thornback venom sac.
silk_and_venom.ready_text: Is that thornback silk? And a venom sac, still full. Give them here, {name}, carefully.
silk_and_venom.complete_text: Carefully... there. You've a steady hand, and a strong stomach.
silk_and_venom.first_complete_text: Take these. Silkweave, light as breath and tougher than leather. Wear them into the deep woods.

scales_for_the_nets.name: Scales for the Nets
scales_for_the_nets.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Scales for the Nets. Bring Brina four Mirescale scales.
scales_for_the_nets.ready_text: Scales! Four good ones. Hand them over, {name}.
scales_for_the_nets.complete_text: Tough as horn. These'll hold the net edges for a season. Here's your coin.
scales_for_the_nets.first_complete_text: And take these. I wove scales into the cuffs myself; they'll turn a lizard's spear better than leather.

old_snapjaw.name: Old Snapjaw
old_snapjaw.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Snapjaw. Bring Elder Tamsin the shell of Old Snapjaw, the great turtle of the middle island.
old_snapjaw.ready_text: Is that... it is. Old Snapjaw's shell. Give it here, {name}; let me see it.
old_snapjaw.complete_text: Sixty years he's bitten our nets. The mere is quieter already.
old_snapjaw.first_complete_text: Our smith has waited half his life to work this shell. Here, the first shield from it, and it's yours.

the_drowned_bell.name: The Drowned Bell
the_drowned_bell.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Drowned Bell. Bring Elder Tamsin Captain Maren's bell and two waterlogged lockets from the drowned.
the_drowned_bell.ready_text: The bell... I'd know that sound anywhere. And the lockets. Give them to me, {name}, gently.
the_drowned_bell.complete_text: We'll bury them on the hill, above the water where it can't reach them again. Thank you.
the_drowned_bell.first_complete_text: Here: the pearl. The mere gave it to me when I was a girl. Wear it; perhaps it will be kinder to you.

tusks_for_oswin.name: Tusks for Oswin
tusks_for_oswin.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Tusks for Oswin. Bring Farmer Oswin four boar tusks.
tusks_for_oswin.ready_text: Tusks! Four of them. Let's have them, {name}.
tusks_for_oswin.complete_text: That's four fewer pigs in my rows. Here's your coin.
tusks_for_oswin.first_complete_text: And the gloves I promised. Worn in, but good leather.

the_stolen_harvest.name: The Stolen Harvest
the_stolen_harvest.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Stolen Harvest. Bring Farmer Oswin Garrick's ledger and two brigand armbands.
the_stolen_harvest.ready_text: That's his ledger, all right, and their armbands with it. Give them here, {name}.
the_stolen_harvest.complete_text: Every sack of seed, every hoe. Written down like he meant to pay for them. Well, he's paid now.
the_stolen_harvest.first_complete_text: My father wore this ring every harvest of his life. The Rest owes you; wear it.

old_tatters.name: Old Tatters
old_tatters.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Tatters. Bring Widow Marta the heart of straw from Old Tatters, who walks the south field at night.
old_tatters.ready_text: Red thread. That's his stitching. Give it to me, {name}.
old_tatters.complete_text: There. He can rest now, and so can I.
old_tatters.first_complete_text: His hat. He wore it in the fields every summer. Take it; he'd have liked you.

tokens_of_the_fallen.name: Tokens of the Fallen
tokens_of_the_fallen.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Tokens of the Fallen. Bring Pilgrim-Mother Ysolde four pilgrims' tokens.
tokens_of_the_fallen.ready_text: Four tokens. Four names I can say at the dawn rite. Give them here, {name}.
tokens_of_the_fallen.complete_text: The Dawn-Tusk remembers them now. Take this, for the road.
tokens_of_the_fallen.first_complete_text: And my boots. They climbed every step of the way up; let them climb the rest with you.

the_unrisen.name: The Unrisen
the_unrisen.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Unrisen. Bring Pilgrim-Mother Ysolde the golden scarab of Sahkrin, who rises at night in the Pilgrims' Rest.
the_unrisen.ready_text: His scarab. It's warm, even now. Give it to me, {name}.
the_unrisen.complete_text: Sleep, Sahkrin. The sun you promised them came up without you.
the_unrisen.first_complete_text: The Dawn-Tusk's pendant. Wear it into the light.

the_false_sun.name: The False Sun
the_false_sun.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The False Sun. Bring Dov the Hierophant's mask and three False-Sun sigils.
the_false_sun.ready_text: That's his mask, all right, and their sigils. Hand them over, {name}.
the_false_sun.complete_text: The pilgrims will sleep easier. So will I.
the_false_sun.first_complete_text: Sunbreaker. I've kept it for someone who'd earn it. That's you.

stingers_for_the_road.name: Stingers for the Salt Road
stingers_for_the_road.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Stingers for the Salt Road. Bring Caravan-Master Suri four scorpion stingers.
stingers_for_the_road.ready_text: Stingers! Four of them. Careful handing them over, {name}.
stingers_for_the_road.complete_text: Lanternhold's apothecaries will pay well for these. Here's your share.
stingers_for_the_road.first_complete_text: And the boots I promised. Salt won't eat these.

the_salt_wolf.name: The Salt-Wolf
the_salt_wolf.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Salt-Wolf. Bring Caravan-Master Suri the warhorn of Vashti, chief of the Salt Raiders.
the_salt_wolf.ready_text: That horn. I've heard it in my sleep. Give it here, {name}.
the_salt_wolf.complete_text: No more warhorns on the salt road. The caravans owe you.
the_salt_wolf.first_complete_text: His blade. He'd want it swinging again.

heart_of_the_titan.name: Heart of the Titan
heart_of_the_titan.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Heart of the Titan. Bring Saltmaster Ibrem the heart from the Bone Titan's ribcage.
heart_of_the_titan.ready_text: It's still warm. By the salt... give it here, {name}.
heart_of_the_titan.complete_text: Let it stop at last. The bones will lie easier.
heart_of_the_titan.first_complete_text: The talisman, carved from its first bone, as promised.

lagoon_snapper.name: Snapper for Oji
lagoon_snapper.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Snapper for Oji. Bring Fisher Oji four lagoon snapper.
lagoon_snapper.ready_text: Four snapper! Good ones, too. Hand them here, {name}.
lagoon_snapper.complete_text: Supper for half the docks. Here's your share.
lagoon_snapper.first_complete_text: And the slicker. Keeps the rain off, mostly.

troll_tusks.name: Troll Tusks
troll_tusks.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Troll Tusks. Bring Hunter Asha four troll tusks.
troll_tusks.ready_text: Four tusks. The Mudtooths will feel that. Give them here, {name}.
troll_tusks.complete_text: Every tusk is one less troll on the river. Here.
troll_tusks.first_complete_text: And the gloves. Troll hide knits itself; so will you, a little.

the_stone_crown.name: The Stone Crown
the_stone_crown.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Stone Crown. Bring Hunter Asha the stone crown of Gorrak Mudtooth, chief of the river trolls.
the_stone_crown.ready_text: That's his crown. I can smell the river on it. Give it here, {name}.
the_stone_crown.complete_text: The Mudtooths will be fighting over who's chief for a year. Good.
the_stone_crown.first_complete_text: The Tidewarden's blade. He'd be glad of the hand that holds it now.

heart_of_the_storm.name: Heart of the Storm
heart_of_the_storm.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Heart of the Storm. Bring Tidepriest Nalini the heart of the Weeping Storm, at the old temple in the Weeping Throat.
heart_of_the_storm.ready_text: It's still crackling... give it to me, gently, {name}.
heart_of_the_storm.first_complete_text: The Tide-Trunk Charm, blessed at this shrine. Wear it into the rain.

graveljaws_tooth.name: Graveljaw's Tooth
graveljaws_tooth.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Graveljaw's Tooth. Bring Hunter Asha the tooth of Old Graveljaw, the ancient crocodile of the Throat's southwestern swamp.
graveljaws_tooth.ready_text: Ten years I've chased him. Give it here, {name}.

bloodtusk_tusks.name: Tusks for the Watch
bloodtusk_tusks.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Tusks for the Watch. Bring Sergeant Harlan four Bloodtusk tusks.
bloodtusk_tusks.ready_text: Bloodtusk tusks. You've been up the east road, {name}. Hand them here.
bloodtusk_tusks.complete_text: Four fewer raiders on my road. The Watch pays for every four you bring me.
bloodtusk_tusks.first_complete_text: And take this bracer. Patrol issue; it's turned more orc blades than I can count.

grolthars_necklace.name: The Warchief's Trophies
grolthars_necklace.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Warchief's Trophies. Bring Sergeant Harlan the tusk necklace Warchief Grolthar wears.
grolthars_necklace.ready_text: Is that... Grolthar's necklace? Then the warchief is dead. Give it here, {name}.
grolthars_necklace.complete_text: Every tusk on this string was a life. They'll be buried properly now, and the Bloodtusk will know their warchief fell to Emberhold.
grolthars_necklace.first_complete_text: Take my old blade. I carried it up this road for twelve years. It's earned a better arm than mine.

the_hollow_watch.name: Rest for the Hollow Watch
the_hollow_watch.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Rest for the Hollow Watch. Bring Elowen the signet Captain Veyl wears.
the_hollow_watch.ready_text: That ring. Veyl's signet, the Watch's seal. You've set him free, {name}. Give it to me.
the_hollow_watch.complete_text: I'll bury it under the obelisk, where the Watch can see the road they swore to guard. They'll rest now.
the_hollow_watch.first_complete_text: The captain wore this pendant with his signet. I kept it all these years. It's yours now; wear it for the Watch.

tenzins_beads.name: Rites for the Fallen
tenzins_beads.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Rites for the Fallen. Bring Brother Tenzin four prayer beads from the fallen monks.
tenzins_beads.ready_text: Their beads. I can feel the anger in them still. Give them to me, {name}.
tenzins_beads.complete_text: There. Four brothers at rest. The order thanks you, what is left of it.
tenzins_beads.first_complete_text: Take my hand wraps. I have no use for fists now.

the_abbots_seal.name: The Abbot's Seal
the_abbots_seal.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Abbot's Seal. Bring Brother Tenzin the seal Abbot Varun carries.
the_abbots_seal.ready_text: The seal of the order. So Varun is gone. Give it here, {name}.
the_abbots_seal.complete_text: I will lay it on the altar at dawn. The Order of the Dawn-Tusk ends today, with grace.
the_abbots_seal.first_complete_text: These beads have been round my neck since I was a boy. Wear them.

the_colossus_heart.name: A Heart of Stone
the_colossus_heart.accept_text: You have taken on a task: A Heart of Stone. Bring Brother Tenzin the Terrace Colossus's heartstone.
the_colossus_heart.ready_text: It still glows. It remembers the dawn. Give it to me, {name}.
the_colossus_heart.complete_text: The guardians of the courts will sleep now.
the_colossus_heart.first_complete_text: Set in a ring, as I promised. It will keep you standing.

pemas_talons.name: Talons for the Pickers
pemas_talons.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Talons for the Pickers. Bring Tea-Mother Pema four harpy talons.
pemas_talons.ready_text: Harpy talons! Hand them over, dear.
pemas_talons.complete_text: The pickers will sleep better. Here's your coin, and a cup of tea on the house.

skyrends_plume.name: The Matriarch's Plume
skyrends_plume.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Matriarch's Plume. Bring Tea-Mother Pema a plume from Skyrend the Matriarch.
skyrends_plume.ready_text: That's her plume, sure as the dawn. Give it here, {name}.
skyrends_plume.complete_text: Let me stitch this. There. The wind itself will slide off you.

ember_sigils.name: Sigils of the Ember
ember_sigils.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Sigils of the Ember. Bring Scout-Captain Brenna four ember sigils.
ember_sigils.ready_text: Ember sigils. Good work, {name}. Hand them over.
ember_sigils.complete_text: Four fewer fanatics. Forgehold pays for every four.
ember_sigils.first_complete_text: And a scout's signet. You've earned it.

ashkars_brand.name: The Pyromancer's Brand
ashkars_brand.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Pyromancer's Brand. Bring Scout-Captain Brenna the brand High Pyromancer Ashkar carries.
ashkars_brand.ready_text: That's his brand. Ashkar is dead? Give it here, {name}.
ashkars_brand.complete_text: The cult will scatter without him. Forgehold owes you.
ashkars_brand.first_complete_text: Take this blade. It was forged for the Captain of the Scouts, and I'd rather it went to you.

drake_scales.name: Obsidian Drake Scales
drake_scales.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Obsidian Drake Scales. Bring Drakewarden Solveig three obsidian drake scales.
drake_scales.first_complete_text: Leggings of their scales, as I promised.

cindermaws_heart.name: The Heart of Cindermaw
cindermaws_heart.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Heart of Cindermaw. Bring Smith Tovar the heart of the great drake Cindermaw.
cindermaws_heart.ready_text: Cindermaw's heart, and still smoldering. Give it to me, {name}.
cindermaws_heart.complete_text: I'll quench the finest blade of my life in this.
cindermaws_heart.first_complete_text: And a cloak of its kin's scales for you. Fire won't bite through it.

pondkin_fetishes.name: Fetishes of the Pondkin
pondkin_fetishes.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Fetishes of the Pondkin. Bring Reedcutter Pallavi four pondkin fetishes.
pondkin_fetishes.complete_text: Four fewer spears in the reeds. Here's your pay.
pondkin_fetishes.first_complete_text: And the boots. They won't sink.

bloatking_crown.name: The Bloatking's Crown
bloatking_crown.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Bloatking's Crown. Bring Reedcutter Pallavi the crown of Bloatking Ghurr.
bloatking_crown.ready_text: That's his crown, rust and shells. Give it here, {name}.
bloatking_crown.complete_text: The reed beds are ours again. Rainhold thanks you.
bloatking_crown.first_complete_text: Take his scepter too; you've earned it more than he did.

reedstalker_plumes.name: Plumes for Fletching
reedstalker_plumes.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Plumes for Fletching. Bring Boatwright Kesh four reedstalker plumes.
reedstalker_plumes.ready_text: Reedstalker plumes, and fine ones. Hand them over.
reedstalker_plumes.complete_text: That's a quiver's worth of fletching. Here's your coin.

stilt_legs_plume.name: The Great Heron
stilt_legs_plume.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Great Heron. Bring Boatwright Kesh a plume of Old Stilt-Legs.
stilt_legs_plume.ready_text: That's the old one's plume, sure enough. Give it here, {name}.
stilt_legs_plume.first_complete_text: Your cloak. The rain will run right off it.

sunken_charms.name: Rest for Veyamar
sunken_charms.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Rest for Veyamar. Bring Priestess Amrit four sunken charms.
sunken_charms.ready_text: The charms of Veyamar. Give them to me, gently.
sunken_charms.complete_text: I will sing them to Jalendra. Four souls go home tonight.

headwomans_lotus.name: The Headwoman's Lotus
headwomans_lotus.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Headwoman's Lotus. Bring Priestess Amrit the lotus of Headwoman Ishani the Sunken.
headwomans_lotus.ready_text: Ishani's lotus. Her people will follow her now. Give it to me.
headwomans_lotus.first_complete_text: This locket was hers. She would want it worn by the living.

marrowroot_heart.name: The Coven's Heart
marrowroot_heart.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Coven's Heart. Bring Priestess Amrit the heart of Mother Marrowroot.
marrowroot_heart.ready_text: It still beats. Give it to me, quickly.
marrowroot_heart.complete_text: The coven is broken. The fen will quiet now.
marrowroot_heart.first_complete_text: Wear this charm; no hex will hold you.

tidesworn_insignias.name: The Tide Kings' Insignia
tidesworn_insignias.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Tide Kings' Insignia. Bring Tidewarden Nkemi four tidesworn insignias.
tidesworn_insignias.ready_text: Royal insignia, green with age. Give them here, {name}.
tidesworn_insignias.complete_text: Four more of the garrison at rest. Rainhold pays.
tidesworn_insignias.first_complete_text: And a blade from our armory. It was forged to fight them.

varundra_crown.name: The Drowned Crown
varundra_crown.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Drowned Crown. Bring Tidewarden Nkemi the crown of Tideking Varundra.
varundra_crown.ready_text: The crown of the Tide Kings. Is the rain... easing? Give it here, {name}.
varundra_crown.first_complete_text: His helm was found beside the throne. It's yours.

naga_scales.name: Scales of the Deep
naga_scales.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Scales of the Deep. Bring Pearl-Diver Suriya four naga scales.
naga_scales.complete_text: That's a season's diving paid for. Here's your share.

sessavi_pearl.name: The Queen's Pearl
sessavi_pearl.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Queen's Pearl. Bring Pearl-Diver Suriya the pearl of Queen Sessavi.
sessavi_pearl.ready_text: The pearl of the deeps. I've dreamed of it. Give it here.
sessavi_pearl.first_complete_text: Wear it; the deep sea will know you.

tempest_shards.name: Shards of the Storm
tempest_shards.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Shards of the Storm. Bring Stormsage Obi four tempest shards.
tempest_shards.ready_text: Tempest shards, still crackling. Give them here.
tempest_shards.complete_text: The storm grows weaker, I think. Here's your pay.

wardens_chain.name: The Warden's Chain
wardens_chain.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Warden's Chain. Bring Stormsage Obi the chain of the Stormbound Warden.
wardens_chain.ready_text: The Warden's chain. It hums. Give it here.
wardens_chain.complete_text: The storm has lost its keeper.
wardens_chain.first_complete_text: A bracer forged from its links. Lightning won't find you.

chitterjaw_claw.name: The Great Crab's Claw
chitterjaw_claw.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Great Crab's Claw. Bring Stormsage Obi the claw of Old Chitterjaw.
chitterjaw_claw.ready_text: That claw could crush a boat. Give it here, {name}.
chitterjaw_claw.complete_text: I'll shape it with a storm-hammer.

dewstep_moth_wings.name: Moths in the Lamps
dewstep_moth_wings.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Moths in the Lamps. Bring Headpicker Anjali four lantern moth wings.
dewstep_moth_wings.complete_text: Four fewer moths in the young leaves. Here's your coin.
dewstep_moth_wings.first_complete_text: And the sandals. They were my daughter's.

pilfers_bangle.name: The Troop-King's Bangle
pilfers_bangle.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Troop-King's Bangle. Bring Headpicker Anjali Pilfer's bangle and two stolen trinkets.
pilfers_bangle.ready_text: That's the tea house's bangle! Give it here, {name}.
pilfers_bangle.complete_text: The orchard will be quieter now.
pilfers_bangle.first_complete_text: Take this ring. It catches the dawn.

jackal_pelts.name: Jackal Pelts
jackal_pelts.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Jackal Pelts. Bring Hunter Kaveri three jackal pelts.

cobra_fangs.name: Cobra Fangs
cobra_fangs.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Cobra Fangs. Bring Hunter Kaveri three cobra fangs.
cobra_fangs.first_complete_text: The dagger, as promised. Mind the point.

amberstripes_fang.name: Amberstripe's Fang
amberstripes_fang.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Amberstripe's Fang. Bring Hunter Kaveri the old tigress's fang.
amberstripes_fang.ready_text: Her fang. She was a queen of the woods, {name}.
amberstripes_fang.complete_text: The pickers can walk the south road again.
amberstripes_fang.first_complete_text: Wear her kin's stripes. You earned them.

dustpaw_beads.name: Dustpaw Beads
dustpaw_beads.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Dustpaw Beads. Bring Warden Tashi four Dustpaw bead strings.
dustpaw_beads.first_complete_text: Take a buckler from our stores.

rattlejaws_necklace.name: Rattlejaw's Necklace
rattlejaws_necklace.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Rattlejaw's Necklace. Bring Warden Tashi the trophy necklace of Chief Rattlejaw.
rattlejaws_necklace.complete_text: Without their chief the Dustpaw will scatter for a while.
rattlejaws_necklace.first_complete_text: A dawnsteel blade, from the city forges.

wisp_lights.name: Quieting the Wisps
wisp_lights.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Quieting the Wisps. Bring Brother Ravi three wisp lights.
wisp_lights.ready_text: Gently, {name}. Put them in the jar.
wisp_lights.first_complete_text: Take these beads, and pray on them.

widows_lantern.name: The Widow's Lantern
widows_lantern.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Widow's Lantern. Bring Brother Ravi the Lantern-Widow's lantern.
widows_lantern.complete_text: I will light it at the shrine, and she can stop waiting.
widows_lantern.first_complete_text: Take this charm; it was blessed at the Dawn Shrine.

giants_coals.name: Giants' Heart-Coals
giants_coals.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Giants' Heart-Coals. Bring Warden Dagny four giant's heart-coals.
giants_coals.complete_text: Forgehold pays for every giant it doesn't have to fight.
giants_coals.first_complete_text: And my gauntlets. Don't take them off near the forges.

thanes_crown.name: The Thane's Iron Crown
thanes_crown.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Thane's Iron Crown. Bring Warden Dagny Thane Korrok's iron crown.
thanes_crown.ready_text: The thane's crown. It's still hot, {name}.
thanes_crown.complete_text: The giants will fight among themselves for a while now.
thanes_crown.first_complete_text: His hammer too. Can you even lift it?

imp_horns.name: Imp Horns
imp_horns.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Imp Horns. Bring Old Sawyer Mott four imp horns.

rain_pack_needles.name: A Pack for the Rain (1 of 3)
rain_pack_needles.accept_text: You have taken on a task: A Pack for the Rain. Bring Provisioner Tamu four bone chips.
rain_pack_needles.ready_text: Bone chips! Four good ones? Give them here, {name}.
rain_pack_needles.complete_text: A little filing, a little patience... there. Netting needles, the old way. Bone doesn't swell in the rain the way wood does.
rain_pack_needles.first_complete_text: A Rainhold pack is netted, not sewn. Take these needles to Fisher Oji on the south docks and ask about [Tamu]. Oji knots the best net in the city, and will want a fish or two for the oil.

rain_pack_net.name: A Pack for the Rain (2 of 3)
rain_pack_net.accept_text: You have taken on a task: A Pack for the Rain. Bring Fisher Oji Tamu's needles and two lagoon snapper.
rain_pack_net.ready_text: Tamu's needles, and snapper with them. Let's have them, {name}.
rain_pack_net.complete_text: Snapper oil in the knots, and the rain runs straight off. Knot, pull, knot... there. The tightest net on the docks.
rain_pack_net.first_complete_text: Take it back to Tamu, and tell Tamu that Oji says the last net still isn't paid for.

rain_pack_clasp.name: A Pack for the Rain (3 of 3)
rain_pack_clasp.accept_text: You have taken on a task: A Pack for the Rain. Bring Provisioner Tamu the oiled net and three gnoll fangs for the toggles.
rain_pack_clasp.ready_text: Oji's net? And fangs for the toggles! Hand them over, {name}.
rain_pack_clasp.complete_text: Gnoll fang toggles: they hold fast wet or dry, and nothing in a Rainhold pack ever comes out damp.
rain_pack_clasp.first_complete_text: Here. A pack for the rain, the only one I'll make this season. Mind the gnolls in Greenmoor don't want their teeth back.

picker_satchel_thread.name: The Tea-Picker's Satchel (1 of 3)
picker_satchel_thread.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Tea-Picker's Satchel. Bring Tea-Seller Moti four lantern moth wings.
picker_satchel_thread.ready_text: Moth wings! Four of them? Give them here, {name}.
picker_satchel_thread.complete_text: Soak the wings, tease out the silk, spin it fine... there. Moth-silk thread, light as steam and twice as strong as cotton.
picker_satchel_thread.first_complete_text: Now the satchel itself. Headpicker Anjali stitches the pickers' satchels; take her this thread and ask her about [Moti]. She'll want jackal hide for the body.

picker_satchel_body.name: The Tea-Picker's Satchel (2 of 3)
picker_satchel_body.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Tea-Picker's Satchel. Bring Headpicker Anjali the moth-silk thread and two jackal pelts.
picker_satchel_body.ready_text: Moti's thread, and good pelts too. Let's have them, {name}.
picker_satchel_body.complete_text: Jackal hide on the outside for the thorns, silk stitching so it never snags a leaf... there. Every picker in Dewstep carries one like it.
picker_satchel_body.first_complete_text: Take it back to Moti for the clasp. And tell Moti I want my good shears back.

picker_satchel_clasp.name: The Tea-Picker's Satchel (3 of 3)
picker_satchel_clasp.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Tea-Picker's Satchel. Bring Tea-Seller Moti the stitched satchel and two rice beetle shells for the clasp.
picker_satchel_clasp.ready_text: Anjali's stitching! And shells for the clasp. Give them over, {name}.
picker_satchel_clasp.complete_text: Rice beetle shell, polished and lacquered: it shines like the lanterns and never cracks.
picker_satchel_clasp.first_complete_text: Here. A tea-picker's satchel, fit for the Dawn-Tusk's own gardens. Carry it well.

wallow_wetbelly.name: Wetbelly's Crown

wallow_gulpmaw.first_complete_text: Gorra made this from its hide while you were gone. Don't ask how.

bogtanner_skins.first_complete_text: Hunter Snikk out in the Wallow sews the old way. Take him this and ask him about [Gorra]; he'll want leech teeth for the stitching.

bogtanner_stitch.name: The Bogtanner's Pack (2 of 3)

bogtanner_stitch.first_complete_text: Back to Gorra for the clasp. She'll want a mud turtle's shell for it.

bogtanner_clasp.name: The Bogtanner's Pack (3 of 3)

bogtanner_clasp.first_complete_text: It's yours, {name}. Don't fill it with frogs.

dusk_silkmother.name: The Silkmother's Fang

silkweave_body.name: The Silkweave Satchel (2 of 3)

rotfen_gristlewort.first_complete_text: Her amulet. The coven's power, turned to our use.

merricks_line_sinew.name: A Line That'll Hold (1)
merricks_line_sinew.accept_text: You have taken on a task: A Line That'll Hold. Bring Merrick five lengths of rat sinew from the large rats of Greenmoor.
merricks_line_sinew.ready_text: I can smell it from here. That's rat sinew you're carrying, {name}. Hand it over.
complete_text: Ha! You actually brought it. Five lengths, still warm. I was sure the rats would send you home empty-handed.
Alright. You earned the full story.
I thought the water just turned. Bad season. Algae. Gnolls dumping their mess upstream. That's what I told the bar.
I was wrong about the why. Not about the where.

Greenmoor's water starts in a cave under the first hills. Whole zone drinks from that spring. I followed the sour taste as far as the mouth. Something in the deep is fouling the source. That's why the fish won't take a hook.
You walked Greenmoor and came back. That counts for something. Might be enough to put the spring right.
Safer with a party. Friends at your back, fewer graves. And nobody goes down there alone anymore; the Watch has a man posted at the cave mouth to see to that.
Corran. Watchman Corran. He owes me for thirty years of fish. I'll send word that you're coming, and he'll go down with you. Keep him alive and he'll keep you alive.
Go look. Don't drink what's down there. Bring me word of what's rotting the water, or kill it, if it has a throat.

merricks_line_spring.name: The Sour Spring (2)
merricks_line_spring.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Sour Spring. Meet Watchman Corran at the cave mouth in Greenmoor's western hills; go down with him, find what is fouling the spring, and put it right.
merricks_line_spring.ready_text: The crystal's light flickers under its webs as you come near. The Blight Heart in your pack twitches, as if it knows.
complete_text: You press the Blight Heart to the crystal. It hisses, blackens and crumbles to ash.
Light floods up through the crystal. The webs shrivel and fall away; the eggs stuck to it split and go still.
The spring stirs. Where the water touches the crystal the green sourness thins, and then it's gone: clear, cold water, running fast toward Greenmoor.
merricks_line_spring.first_complete_text: You fill a vial from the clean spring. Merrick will want to see this.

hints.blight_heart: the Blightmother carries it, in the spring cavern at the very end of the Wellspring (the cave in Greenmoor's western hills).

merricks_line_word.name: Word for Merrick (3)
merricks_line_word.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Word for Merrick. Bring Merrick the Blightmother's venom sac, proof of what was in his water.
merricks_line_word.ready_text: You're back. You found it, didn't you? I can see it on you. Show me, {name}.
complete_text: That's... that came out of something living? In our spring?
A spider the size of a cart, sitting on the source, and all of Greenmoor drinking what she dripped. No wonder the fish went off their food.
And the water runs clean down there now, you say. Clean at the source.
Thirty years I've heard stories told at this bar, {name}. I'll believe this one when I see it with my own eyes.
Meet me at the pond. Bring that vial.

merricks_line_pond.name: The Proof in the Water (4)
merricks_line_pond.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Proof in the Water. Meet Merrick at his pond in Greenmoor, running clean again, and give him the vial of spring water.
merricks_line_pond.ready_text: Look at it, {name}. Just look at it. Clear to the bottom. Let's have that vial.
complete_text: Straight from the spring, is it? Same cold, same clean. That's the water I remember.
I haven't seen the bottom of this pond in a year. The scum's gone, the stink's gone. You did that, you and Corran.
Now then. Line in the water. Let's see.
There! You feel that? A bite! A real bite!
Thirty years I've fished this pond, {name}, and I've never been so glad to feel a fish pull.
Come by any time. Poles and bait, same as ever. And if Old Gulper ever shows his face again, you'll be the first to know.

dimming_line_wings.name: What the Moths Carry (1)
dimming_line_wings.accept_text: You have taken on a task: What the Moths Carry. Bring Naevys five wings from the gloomwing moths of Duskwood.
dimming_line_wings.ready_text: That's moth-dust on your hands, {name}. You have them. Give them here.
complete_text: Hold one up to the dark. There. See it? That shimmer on the scales, violet, like the lamps. That is not moonlight, {name}. That is ours.
Five moths, half a league from here, and every one of them dusted with Duskhold's light. They've been feeding below and flying out through the wood.
I said so. I said so to the Lamp-Keeper's face, and she had my rank for it.

The crack behind me runs down into the old crystal workings: the Gloamvein. The Heartcrystal is down there, the one every lamp in the city was cut from. If something is drinking that, Duskhold goes dark one lamp at a time.
My orders are to stand at this wall. They say nothing about which side of it.
I'm going down, {name}, and you're coming with me. You lead; I'll keep them off you. Walk into the crack when you're ready and I'll be at your back.

hints.moth_wing: the gloomwing moths of Duskwood carry them: out Duskhold's gate and up the tunnel, among the trees round the cave mouth.

dimming_line_deep.name: The Dark Below (2)
dimming_line_deep.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Dark Below. Go down into the Gloamvein with Naevys, through the crack in Duskhold's southwest wall; find what is drinking the Heartcrystal's light, and give the light back.
dimming_line_deep.ready_text: The Heartcrystal's light stirs under its silk as you come near. The knot of stolen light in your pack grows warm and pulls toward it.
complete_text: You press the knot of stolen light to the silk. It sinks through like water into sand.
The Heartcrystal drinks. Violet fire climbs through it from root to tip; the cocoon blackens, splits and slides to the floor.
One by one, back along the vein, the dead crystals catch. Somewhere far above you, Duskhold's lamps are waking.
dimming_line_deep.first_complete_text: A sliver cracks from the Heartcrystal and drops, glowing, into your hand.

hints.stolen_light: the Lamp-Glutton carries it, in the Heartcrystal's chamber at the very end of the Gloamvein (the crack in Duskhold's southwest wall).

dimming_line_lantern.name: A Lamp Left Burning (3)
dimming_line_lantern.accept_text: You have taken on a task: A Lamp Left Burning. Bring Naevys, at her post by the crack in Duskhold's southwest wall, the lantern from the Lamp-Glutton's nest.
dimming_line_lantern.ready_text: You're carrying something out of that nest, {name}. I can smell it from here. Show me.
complete_text: A lantern. In her nest.

Smell that glass. Sweet. That's moth-musk: the keepers paint it on the shrine candles to bring the little ones in. Somebody painted a lamp with it, carried it down a sealed vein, and left it burning beside the Heartcrystal.
Moths don't light lanterns, {name}. She didn't find her way down there. She was called.
And this is shrine glass. Half the pilgrims in Duskhold carry one like it. It could be anyone's. That's the trouble with it.
I'm done standing at a wall. The lamps are lit and the whole city can see it; let them tell me I imagined that.
Meet me on the shrine island, by the Lamp-Eater's idol. Bring the shard the Heartcrystal gave you. I want the Lamp-Keeper to look at it while I look at her.

hints.painted_lantern: it lies in the Lamp-Glutton's nest, at the very end of the Gloamvein; she drops it.

dimming_line_shard.name: Light for the Lamp-Keeper (4)
dimming_line_shard.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Light for the Lamp-Keeper. Meet Naevys on Duskhold's shrine island, by the Lamp-Eater's idol, and give her the Heartcrystal shard.
dimming_line_shard.ready_text: Good. Don't hide it, {name}. Hold it where the Lamp-Keeper can see.
complete_text: There. Now she's seen it. And before I say my piece to her, {name}: something of yours.
Now. Lamp-Keeper. That is a sliver of the Heartcrystal, and it is burning. It wasn't, a day ago. Your goddess's child was sitting on it, drinking this city dark, exactly as I reported.
...Nothing to say. No. I didn't think there would be.
They won't give me my rank back, {name}. That would mean writing down that I was right. But nobody has ordered me back to the wall, either, and I notice the armory door was left open.
So I'll stand where I please. Here, mostly. Somebody in this city trimmed that lantern's wick, and I intend to be looking at them when they light the next one.
dimming_line_shard.first_complete_text: You went into the dark for a city that hadn't asked you to. A sentinel is owed her kit for that. I drew it from the armory myself.

march_pelts.name: Wolves of the March
march_pelts.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Wolves of the March. Bring Marchwarden Hale four march wolf pelts.
march_pelts.complete_text: Four fewer wolves on the road.
march_pelts.first_complete_text: Take this cloak. Wardens wear them; you've earned one.

march_tokens.name: The Marchreavers
march_tokens.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Marchreavers. Bring Marchwarden Hale three Marchreaver's tokens.
march_tokens.complete_text: Three reavers who won't rob anyone again.
march_tokens.first_complete_text: Their own boots. Fitting, I think.

march_corvel.name: Redhand Corvel
march_corvel.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Redhand Corvel. Bring Marchwarden Hale Corvel's signet.
march_corvel.complete_text: Rainhold will want this back. The March is quieter already.
march_corvel.first_complete_text: His red glove. Wash it first.

march_scythewing.name: Scythewing
march_scythewing.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Scythewing. Bring Marchwarden Hale one of Scythewing's talons.
march_scythewing.ready_text: That talon's as long as my arm.
march_scythewing.complete_text: The crags are ours again, for a while.
march_scythewing.first_complete_text: Wear it on a cord. Wyverns will know.

march_grave_iron.name: Grave-Iron
march_grave_iron.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Grave-Iron. Bring Gravekeeper Ossa three grave-iron shards.
march_grave_iron.first_complete_text: I bent a band from the first of it. Wear it.

march_marshal.name: The Hollow Marshal
march_marshal.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Hollow Marshal. Bring Gravekeeper Ossa the Hollow Marshal's seal.
march_marshal.ready_text: His seal. You fought him in the dark?
march_marshal.complete_text: The keep will be quieter tonight.
march_marshal.first_complete_text: His blade broke on your armor, maybe. It still cuts.

gorge_tusks.name: Stonefist Tusks
gorge_tusks.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Stonefist Tusks. Bring Ropewarden Mbeki three Stonefist troll tusks.
gorge_tusks.complete_text: Three trolls who won't foul the river.
gorge_tusks.first_complete_text: Ropewalker's gloves. You'll want them on the bridges.

gorge_grukk.name: Chief Grukk Stonefist
gorge_grukk.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Chief Grukk Stonefist. Bring Ropewarden Mbeki Chief Grukk's knuckle-bone.
gorge_grukk.complete_text: The camp will fight over his place for a season. Good.
gorge_grukk.first_complete_text: His girdle. Trolls make good leather, it turns out.

gorge_feathers.name: Griffon Feathers
gorge_feathers.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Griffon Feathers. Bring Ropewarden Mbeki four griffon feathers.
gorge_feathers.ready_text: Feathers. The fletchers will be pleased.
gorge_feathers.complete_text: Four griffons fewer over our goats.
gorge_feathers.first_complete_text: A mantle of their feathers. Light as rain.

gorge_stormcrest.name: Stormcrest
gorge_stormcrest.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Stormcrest. Bring Ropewarden Mbeki Stormcrest's crest plume.
gorge_stormcrest.first_complete_text: Wear it. Every griffon in the Monsoon will know what you did.

gorge_essence.name: Spirits of the Falls
gorge_essence.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Spirits of the Falls. Bring Tidepriestess Lirien three essences of the falls.
gorge_essence.first_complete_text: Jalendra's pendant. The water will know you.

gorge_voice.name: The Voice of the Falls
gorge_voice.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Voice of the Falls. Bring Tidepriestess Lirien the Heart of the Cataract.
gorge_voice.complete_text: Listen: the falls have gone quiet.
gorge_voice.first_complete_text: A staff cut from the gorge's own stone. It hums when it rains.

tw_tusker_tusks.name: Tusker Tusks
tw_tusker_tusks.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Tusker Tusks. Bring Hob the Woodcutter four thornwood tusker tusks.
tw_tusker_tusks.ready_text: Tusks! The Patrol will pay double for these.
tw_tusker_tusks.complete_text: Four fewer tuskers rooting through our things.

tw_old_greyback.name: Old Greyback
tw_old_greyback.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Greyback. Bring Hob the Woodcutter the scarred hide of Old Greyback.
tw_old_greyback.complete_text: We can come home now. Thank you, {name}.
tw_old_greyback.first_complete_text: My brother's hatchet. He'd want it swinging.

tw_prayer_beads.name: Forsworn Prayer Beads
tw_prayer_beads.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Forsworn Prayer Beads. Bring Corporal Brannic four forsworn prayer beads.

tw_brother_vesk.name: Brother Vesk the Forsworn
tw_brother_vesk.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Brother Vesk the Forsworn. Bring Corporal Brannic Brother Vesk's censer.
tw_brother_vesk.ready_text: The censer. It's gone cold at last.
tw_brother_vesk.complete_text: The shrine's quiet. The Dawn-Tusk can have it back.
tw_brother_vesk.first_complete_text: The Northwatch's cloak. You've earned the colors.

lg_stone_chips.name: Humming Stone
lg_stone_chips.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Humming Stone. Bring Outrider Temperance four humming stone chips.
lg_stone_chips.ready_text: Chips! Put your ear to one.
lg_stone_chips.complete_text: The stonecutters will be up all night.

lg_ringwarden.name: The Ringwarden
lg_ringwarden.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Ringwarden. Bring Outrider Temperance the Ringwarden's rune-stone.
lg_ringwarden.complete_text: The ring is only stones again.
lg_ringwarden.first_complete_text: Cut from its heart. It still hums, a little.

lg_jackal_ears.name: Carrion Jackal Ears
lg_jackal_ears.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Carrion Jackal Ears. Bring Herdwife Saule four carrion jackal ears.

lg_old_rakemaw.name: Old Rakemaw
lg_old_rakemaw.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Rakemaw. Bring Herdwife Saule the jawbone of Old Rakemaw.
lg_old_rakemaw.ready_text: Her jaw. She won't bite again.
lg_old_rakemaw.complete_text: I can bury my husband's things now.
lg_old_rakemaw.first_complete_text: My mantle. Wear it on the plain, it's kept me warm on worse nights.

bl_mine_tags.name: Mine Tags
bl_mine_tags.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Mine Tags. Bring Outrider Kofi four brine-crusted mine tags.
bl_mine_tags.ready_text: Tags. Let me read the names.

bl_foreman_dask.name: Foreman Dask
bl_foreman_dask.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Foreman Dask. Bring Outrider Kofi Foreman Dask's ledger.
bl_foreman_dask.ready_text: The ledger. Every name in it.
bl_foreman_dask.first_complete_text: His belt. It held up a lot of salt.

bl_crab_claws.name: Wreck Crab Claws
bl_crab_claws.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Wreck Crab Claws. Bring Trader Oyelowo four wreck crab claws.

bl_wreck_shell.name: The Wreck-Shell
bl_wreck_shell.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Wreck-Shell. Bring Trader Oyelowo a shard of the Wreck-Shell.
bl_wreck_shell.ready_text: A piece of it. It's really gone.
bl_wreck_shell.first_complete_text: Made from the lead wagon's wheel-guard. Take it.

burn_kindled_husk_q.name: Cinder Rosaries
burn_kindled_husk_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Cinder Rosaries. Bring Ashrunner Beppe four cinder rosary beads.
burn_kindled_husk_q.complete_text: Four husks that won't pray again.

burn_kindled_deacon_q.name: The Kindled Deacon
burn_kindled_deacon_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Kindled Deacon. Bring Ashrunner Beppe the Kindled Deacon's censer.
burn_kindled_deacon_q.complete_text: The chapel burns out at last.
burn_kindled_deacon_q.first_complete_text: The Cinderwatch's mantle. Ash doesn't stick to it.

burn_cinder_newt_q.name: Newt Blisters
burn_cinder_newt_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Newt Blisters. Bring Prospector Renske four cinder newt blisters.

burn_old_blisterback_q.name: Old Blisterback
burn_old_blisterback_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Blisterback. Bring Prospector Renske Old Blisterback's heartstone.
burn_old_blisterback_q.first_complete_text: My old pick. It's dug through worse than him.

mf_drowned_salter_q.name: Salters' Lockets
mf_drowned_salter_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Salters' Lockets. Bring Skiff-Scout Imara four salters' lockets.
mf_drowned_salter_q.ready_text: Lockets. There's a face in this one.

mf_skiffmaster_dunmore_q.name: Skiffmaster Dunmore the Drowned
mf_skiffmaster_dunmore_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Skiffmaster Dunmore the Drowned. Bring Skiff-Scout Imara Skiffmaster Dunmore's logbook.
mf_skiffmaster_dunmore_q.ready_text: His logbook. Every crossing he made.
mf_skiffmaster_dunmore_q.first_complete_text: Boots cut for the glass. You won't slip.

mf_saltglass_sentinel_q.name: Salt-Glass Chips
mf_saltglass_sentinel_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Salt-Glass Chips. Bring Glass-Seeker Wenzel four salt-glass chips.
mf_saltglass_sentinel_q.ready_text: Chips! Look how the light goes through.

mf_pillarmother_q.name: The Pillarmother
mf_pillarmother_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Pillarmother. Bring Glass-Seeker Wenzel the Pillarmother's core.
mf_pillarmother_q.first_complete_text: Ground from the purest glass. See the salt through it.

if_starving_shade_q.name: Shades' Prayer Beads
if_starving_shade_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Shades' Prayer Beads. Bring Pathfinder Anselm four shades' prayer beads.

if_hollow_mahout_q.name: The Hollow Mahout
if_hollow_mahout_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Hollow Mahout. Bring Pathfinder Anselm the Hollow Mahout's goad.
if_hollow_mahout_q.ready_text: His goad. The herds are free of him.
if_hollow_mahout_q.first_complete_text: A cowl the Tuskwatch wore at the gate. Take it.

if_marrow_beetle_q.name: Marrow Beetle Shells
if_marrow_beetle_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Marrow Beetle Shells. Bring Bone-Carver Ulrike four marrow beetle shells.

if_marrow_queen_q.name: The Marrow Queen
if_marrow_queen_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Marrow Queen. Bring Bone-Carver Ulrike the Marrow Queen's mandible.
if_marrow_queen_q.first_complete_text: My carving gloves. Keep your fingers.

rm_drowned_ringer_q.name: Bell Clappers
rm_drowned_ringer_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Bell Clappers. Bring Reedwatcher Achebe four tarnished bell clappers.
rm_drowned_ringer_q.ready_text: Clappers. They'll ring no more floods.

rm_bellwarden_q.name: The Bellwarden
rm_bellwarden_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Bellwarden. Bring Reedwatcher Achebe the Bellwarden's bell.
rm_bellwarden_q.first_complete_text: The Heronwatch's blade. It's cut a lot of reeds.

rm_weir_eel_q.name: Weir Eel Fins
rm_weir_eel_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Weir Eel Fins. Bring Fisher Makena four weir eel fins.

rm_eel_mother_q.name: The Eel-Mother
rm_eel_mother_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Eel-Mother. Bring Fisher Makena the Eel-Mother's eye.
rm_eel_mother_q.ready_text: Her eye. Big as a plate.
rm_eel_mother_q.first_complete_text: My mother's ring. She kept this weir before me.

sr_delta_toad_q.name: Croaker Glands
sr_delta_toad_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Croaker Glands. Bring Channelwatch Ioana four croaker glands.

sr_gulmog_q.name: Gulmog the Bellower
sr_gulmog_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Gulmog the Bellower. Bring Channelwatch Ioana Gulmog's throat-sac.
sr_gulmog_q.ready_text: His throat-sac. The rookery can hear itself think.
sr_gulmog_q.complete_text: No more bellowing on the channels.
sr_gulmog_q.first_complete_text: Channelwatch gloves. They grip wet rope.

sr_mangrove_lurker_q.name: Mangrove Roots
sr_mangrove_lurker_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Mangrove Roots. Bring Herbalist Ama four walking mangrove roots.

sr_old_tanglefoot_q.name: Old Tanglefoot
sr_old_tanglefoot_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Tanglefoot. Bring Herbalist Ama Old Tanglefoot's heartroot.
sr_old_tanglefoot_q.complete_text: The mangroves are only trees again.
sr_old_tanglefoot_q.first_complete_text: Woven from the first roots I ever cut. It keeps your head clear.

bg_obsidian_borer_q.name: Borer Carapaces
bg_obsidian_borer_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Borer Carapaces. Bring Glasswalker Hrafn four obsidian borer carapaces.
bg_obsidian_borer_q.complete_text: Four borers the watch won't hear.

bg_sable_borer_q.name: The Sable Borer
bg_sable_borer_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Sable Borer. Bring Glasswalker Hrafn the Sable Borer's mandible.
bg_sable_borer_q.ready_text: Its mandible. The watch can lie still.
bg_sable_borer_q.complete_text: The glass keeps its dead now.
bg_sable_borer_q.first_complete_text: Leggings cut from its shell. Nothing on the glass will cut through them.

bg_glass_wisp_q.name: Wisp Prisms
bg_glass_wisp_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Wisp Prisms. Bring Glass-Diviner Tovi four wisp prisms.
bg_glass_wisp_q.ready_text: Prisms! Hold one to the sun.

bg_prism_heart_q.name: Prism-Heart
bg_prism_heart_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Prism-Heart. Bring Glass-Diviner Tovi Prism-Heart's core.
bg_prism_heart_q.first_complete_text: Ground from a prism. You'll see the glass differently now.

sw_spore_shambler_q.name: Spore Sacs
sw_spore_shambler_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Spore Sacs. Bring Woodrunner Kasia four spore sacs.

sw_rotcap_q.name: The Rotcap
sw_rotcap_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Rotcap. Bring Woodrunner Kasia the Rotcap's gills.
sw_rotcap_q.ready_text: Its gills. The hollow will wither.
sw_rotcap_q.complete_text: The moths will have to go elsewhere.
sw_rotcap_q.first_complete_text: The hood I wear in the hollow. The spores can't touch you in it.

sw_kiln_imp_q.name: Kiln Cinders
sw_kiln_imp_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Kiln Cinders. Bring Charcoal-Burner Ottokar four kiln cinders.

sw_old_bellows_q.name: Old Bellows
sw_old_bellows_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Bellows. Bring Charcoal-Burner Ottokar Old Bellows's horn.
sw_old_bellows_q.ready_text: His horn. The kiln's cooling already.
sw_old_bellows_q.complete_text: We'll burn charcoal again by the first frost.
sw_old_bellows_q.first_complete_text: My kiln gloves. They've held hotter things than him.

ss_moor_harrier_q.name: Harrier Feathers
ss_moor_harrier_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Harrier Feathers. Bring Moorrunner Edric four harrier flight-feathers.

ss_old_talonmere_q.name: Old Talonmere
ss_old_talonmere_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Talonmere. Bring Moorrunner Edric Old Talonmere's talon.
ss_old_talonmere_q.ready_text: Her talon. The kites can fly again.
ss_old_talonmere_q.complete_text: Galehold's flyers will be back by spring.
ss_old_talonmere_q.first_complete_text: A Westwatch cloak. It's kept the moor wind off better riders than me.

ss_cairn_wight_q.name: Cairn Bones
ss_cairn_wight_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Cairn Bones. Bring Stone-Reader Mabyn four cairn bones.
ss_cairn_wight_q.ready_text: Bones. I'll lay them back tonight.

ss_cairn_king_q.name: The Cairn-King
ss_cairn_king_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Cairn-King. Bring Stone-Reader Mabyn the Cairn-King's torc.
ss_cairn_king_q.first_complete_text: A reader's torque. The stones speak louder to whoever wears it.

ha_cloud_ray_q.name: Cloud Ray Barbs
ha_cloud_ray_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Cloud Ray Barbs. Bring Skyrunner Odile four cloud ray tail-barbs.
ha_cloud_ray_q.ready_text: Barbs. Careful where you put them.
ha_cloud_ray_q.complete_text: Four rays fewer in the sky.

ha_old_stormbarb_q.name: Old Stormbarb
ha_old_stormbarb_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Stormbarb. Bring Skyrunner Odile Old Stormbarb's spine.
ha_old_stormbarb_q.ready_text: The spine! It's longer than I am.
ha_old_stormbarb_q.complete_text: The sky over the isle is ours.
ha_old_stormbarb_q.first_complete_text: A Highwatch bracer. Keeps the wind off your sword arm.

ha_gale_sprite_q.name: Sprite-Silk Ribbons
ha_gale_sprite_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Sprite-Silk Ribbons. Bring Kitewright Sunniva four sprite-silk ribbons.
ha_gale_sprite_q.ready_text: Ribbons! Look how they flutter with no wind.

ha_gustmother_q.name: The Gustmother
ha_gustmother_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Gustmother. Bring Kitewright Sunniva the Gustmother's breath.
ha_gustmother_q.first_complete_text: My sash. The wind likes whoever wears it.

ff_fog_wraith_q.name: Wraith-Shroud Scraps
ff_fog_wraith_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Wraith-Shroud Scraps. Bring Lanternrunner Quill four wraith-shroud scraps.
ff_fog_wraith_q.complete_text: Four wraiths gone back into the fog.

ff_veiled_chaplain_q.name: The Veiled Chaplain
ff_veiled_chaplain_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Veiled Chaplain. Bring Lanternrunner Quill the Veiled Chaplain's psalter.
ff_veiled_chaplain_q.ready_text: His psalter. The last page is blank.
ff_veiled_chaplain_q.first_complete_text: A lanternrunner's cloak. The fog slides off it.

ff_rubble_golem_q.name: Fogstone Chips
ff_rubble_golem_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Fogstone Chips. Bring Quarryman Bertil four fogstone chips.

ff_old_cairnback_q.name: Old Cairnback
ff_old_cairnback_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Cairnback. Bring Quarryman Bertil Old Cairnback's keystone.
ff_old_cairnback_q.ready_text: The keystone. It's cracked right through.
ff_old_cairnback_q.first_complete_text: My girdle. It's held up under a lot of stone.

un_morvaine_hound_q.name: Silver Collar-Studs
un_morvaine_hound_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Silver Collar-Studs. Bring Lampbearer Ines four silver collar-studs.

un_blackfang_q.name: Blackfang, the Countess's Pet
un_blackfang_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Blackfang, the Countess's Pet. Bring Lampbearer Ines Blackfang's collar.
un_blackfang_q.first_complete_text: A lampbearer's gloves. The dark can't get a grip on you.

un_well_wisp_q.name: Drops of Moonwater
un_well_wisp_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Drops of Moonwater. Bring Well-Warden Oriel four drops of moonwater.
un_well_wisp_q.ready_text: Moonwater. It glows in the jar.

un_pale_keeper_q.name: The Pale Keeper
un_pale_keeper_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Pale Keeper. Bring Well-Warden Oriel the Pale Keeper's lantern.
un_pale_keeper_q.complete_text: The well is only a well again.
un_pale_keeper_q.first_complete_text: My sash. It holds a little of the moon.

lw_blade_sentinel_q.name: Flecks of Divine Steel
lw_blade_sentinel_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Flecks of Divine Steel. Bring Vigilrunner Tamsin four flecks of divine steel.

lw_blades_warden_q.name: The Blade's Warden
lw_blades_warden_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Blade's Warden. Bring Vigilrunner Tamsin the Blade's Warden's hilt-gem.
lw_blades_warden_q.ready_text: The hilt-gem. Still warm from the war.
lw_blades_warden_q.first_complete_text: Pauldrons from the Vigil's armory. The last fire's colors.

lw_godwar_hound_q.name: Godwar Hound Bones
lw_godwar_hound_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Godwar Hound Bones. Bring Excavator Ingrith four godwar hound bones.

lw_ashfang_q.name: Ashfang, Hound of the Last Charge
lw_ashfang_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Ashfang, Hound of the Last Charge. Bring Excavator Ingrith Ashfang's war-collar.
lw_ashfang_q.ready_text: His collar. Look at the work in it.
lw_ashfang_q.first_complete_text: The first thing I ever dug up here. It was lucky for me.

ht_forsaken_pilgrim_q.name: Pilgrims' Prayer Scraps
ht_forsaken_pilgrim_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Pilgrims' Prayer Scraps. Bring Pilgrim-Guide Lobsang four pilgrims' prayer scraps.
ht_forsaken_pilgrim_q.ready_text: Prayers. I'll say them for them.

ht_unshriven_q.name: The Unshriven
ht_unshriven_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Unshriven. Bring Pilgrim-Guide Lobsang the Unshriven's prayer-bell.
ht_unshriven_q.ready_text: His bell. It's quiet at last.
ht_unshriven_q.complete_text: The stupa can be a shrine again.
ht_unshriven_q.first_complete_text: Wraps the pilgrims wear for the climb. Warm hands, steady blade.

ht_high_wolf_q.name: High Wolf Pelts
ht_high_wolf_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: High Wolf Pelts. Bring Herder Dolkar four high wolf pelts.

ht_old_frostjaw_q.name: Old Frostjaw
ht_old_frostjaw_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Frostjaw. Bring Herder Dolkar Old Frostjaw's fang.
ht_old_frostjaw_q.ready_text: His fang. Longer than my thumb.
ht_old_frostjaw_q.first_complete_text: My father's ring. He'd want it on a wolf-killer.

gm_grain_weevil_q.name: Weevil Husks
gm_grain_weevil_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Weevil Husks. Bring Farmwife Gudrun four grain weevil husks.

gm_granary_queen_q.name: The Granary Queen
gm_granary_queen_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Granary Queen. Bring Farmwife Gudrun the Granary Queen's crest.
gm_granary_queen_q.complete_text: We might plant again this spring.
gm_granary_queen_q.first_complete_text: My harvest mittens. Warm hands for cold mornings.

hf_field_crow_q.name: Crow Feathers
hf_field_crow_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Crow Feathers. Bring Crofter Ewan four field crow feathers.

hf_old_blackwing_q.name: Old Blackwing
hf_old_blackwing_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Blackwing. Bring Crofter Ewan Old Blackwing's eye.
hf_old_blackwing_q.first_complete_text: My good boots. For walking the furrows.

hm_marsh_gnats_q.name: Gnat Wings
hm_marsh_gnats_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Gnat Wings. Bring Reedcutter Olwen four marsh gnat wings.

hm_droning_mother_q.name: The Droning Mother
hm_droning_mother_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Droning Mother. Bring Reedcutter Olwen the Droning Mother's egg-sac.
hm_droning_mother_q.first_complete_text: Reed-cutting sleeves. Nothing bites through them.

ds_bamboo_viper_q.name: Viper Skins
ds_bamboo_viper_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Viper Skins. Bring Tea-Roller Sunita four bamboo viper skins.

ds_jade_eye_q.name: Jade-Eye
ds_jade_eye_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Jade-Eye. Bring Tea-Roller Sunita Jade-Eye's fang.
ds_jade_eye_q.ready_text: Her fang. Longer than my finger.
ds_jade_eye_q.complete_text: The pickers can walk to the shrine again.
ds_jade_eye_q.first_complete_text: My rolling gloves. Soft on the leaf, soft on your hands.

su_dust_scarab_q.name: Scarab Shells
su_dust_scarab_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Scarab Shells. Bring Water-Seeker Anil four dust scarab shells.

su_old_dunebore_q.name: Old Dunebore
su_old_dunebore_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Dunebore. Bring Water-Seeker Anil Old Dunebore's horn.
su_old_dunebore_q.ready_text: His horn. The well might fill again.
su_old_dunebore_q.first_complete_text: A seeker's sash. It's found water in worse places.

wt_rain_panther_q.name: Panther Whiskers
wt_rain_panther_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Panther Whiskers. Bring Tracker Mbali four rain panther whiskers.

wt_silkpaw_q.name: Silkpaw
wt_silkpaw_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Silkpaw. Bring Tracker Mbali Silkpaw's pelt.
wt_silkpaw_q.ready_text: Her pelt. Three rains I chased her.
wt_silkpaw_q.complete_text: I can track something else now.
wt_silkpaw_q.first_complete_text: My boots. Quiet on the leaves.

cp_ash_beetle_q.name: Ash Beetle Carapaces
cp_ash_beetle_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Ash Beetle Carapaces. Bring Carter Hodd four ash beetle carapaces.

cp_cinderback_q.name: Cinderback
cp_cinderback_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Cinderback. Bring Carter Hodd Cinderback's ember gland.
cp_cinderback_q.ready_text: The gland. Careful, it's still burning.
cp_cinderback_q.complete_text: I can dig my ore out.

wb_crag_lizard_q.name: Crag Lizard Scales
wb_crag_lizard_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Crag Lizard Scales. Bring Arch-Warden Petra four crag lizard scales.

wb_old_sunbask_q.name: Old Sunbask
wb_old_sunbask_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Sunbask. Bring Arch-Warden Petra Old Sunbask's frill.
wb_old_sunbask_q.complete_text: The arch is ours for the watch.
wb_old_sunbask_q.first_complete_text: A warden's bracer. Cut from the arch's own hide, we say.

wl_bog_crawdad_q.name: Crawdad Tails
wl_bog_crawdad_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Crawdad Tails. Bring Bog-Wife Grunna four bog crawdad tails.

wl_old_pinchmud_q.name: Old Pinchmud
wl_old_pinchmud_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Pinchmud. Bring Bog-Wife Grunna Old Pinchmud's great claw.
wl_old_pinchmud_q.ready_text: His claw! Grunna'll hang it on the door.
wl_old_pinchmud_q.first_complete_text: Grunna's stewing wrap. It's kept her warm by the pot for years.

dk_duskwing_q.name: Duskwing Scales
dk_duskwing_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Duskwing Scales. Bring Moth-Seer Lirael four duskwing wing-scales.

dk_pale_mothmother_q.name: The Pale Mothmother
dk_pale_mothmother_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Pale Mothmother. Bring Moth-Seer Lirael the Pale Mothmother's antenna.
dk_pale_mothmother_q.ready_text: Her antenna. The dusk will be quieter.
dk_pale_mothmother_q.complete_text: The shrine is only stone again.
dk_pale_mothmother_q.first_complete_text: My circlet. It shows you a little of the dusk.

rf_bloated_dead_q.name: Plague Finger-Bones
rf_bloated_dead_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Plague Finger-Bones. Bring Fen-Priest Orun four plague-barge finger-bones.

rf_barge_warden_q.name: The Barge-Warden
rf_barge_warden_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Barge-Warden. Bring Fen-Priest Orun the Barge-Warden's plague-bell.
rf_barge_warden_q.complete_text: I'll burn the barge at last.
rf_barge_warden_q.first_complete_text: Jalendra's charm. The dead don't like it.

bm_cairn_raven_q.name: Raven Quills
bm_cairn_raven_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Raven Quills. Bring Beacon-Keeper Hesk four cairn raven quills.

bm_grimquill_q.name: Grimquill
bm_grimquill_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Grimquill. Bring Beacon-Keeper Hesk Grimquill's beak.
bm_grimquill_q.first_complete_text: A keeper's boots. For the climb to the top.

cp_slag_hound_q.name: Slag Hound Fangs
cp_slag_hound_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Slag Hound Fangs. Bring Ventrunner Odalys four slag hound fangs.
cp_slag_hound_q.ready_text: Fangs. Still hot from the slag.

cp_old_clinkerjaw_q.name: Old Clinkerjaw
cp_old_clinkerjaw_q.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Old Clinkerjaw. Bring Ventrunner Odalys Old Clinkerjaw's molten tooth.
cp_old_clinkerjaw_q.complete_text: The smelter's quiet. The Forge might fire it again.
cp_old_clinkerjaw_q.first_complete_text: The smelterman's belt. It was his, and it's yours now.

tw_offerings.name: Stolen Offerings
tw_offerings.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Stolen Offerings. Bring Keeper Anvesha four stolen pilgrim's offerings.
tw_offerings.ready_text: Offerings! The statues will have them back.
tw_offerings.first_complete_text: Pilgrim's sandals. The road's kinder in them.

tw_jackal_hides.name: Hides for the Shelters
tw_jackal_hides.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Hides for the Shelters. Bring Keeper Anvesha four red-earth jackal hides.
tw_jackal_hides.first_complete_text: A roadwarden's belt. We give them to friends of the road.

tw_ochre_tokens.name: The Ochre Hand
tw_ochre_tokens.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Ochre Hand. Bring Roadwarden Tarun three Ochre Hand tokens.
tw_ochre_tokens.complete_text: Three bandits who won't rob pilgrims again.
tw_ochre_tokens.first_complete_text: Wear their road's cloak, and let them see it.

tw_rhaz.name: Captain Rhaz Ochrehand
tw_rhaz.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Captain Rhaz Ochrehand. Bring Roadwarden Tarun Captain Rhaz's ochre seal.
tw_rhaz.complete_text: The Ochre Hand's broken. The road's ours.
tw_rhaz.first_complete_text: His saber. It's robbed its last pilgrim.

tw_beads.name: Restless Pilgrims
tw_beads.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Restless Pilgrims. Bring Brother Kesav three pilgrim's prayer beads.
tw_beads.ready_text: Their beads. Let me bless them.
tw_beads.complete_text: Three pilgrims who can go on now.
tw_beads.first_complete_text: Wear the first of them. It remembers its prayers.

tw_abbess.name: The Lost Abbess
tw_abbess.accept_text: You have taken on a task: The Lost Abbess. Bring Brother Kesav the Lost Abbess's prayer wheel.
tw_abbess.complete_text: She rests. The Fallen Tusk is quiet.
tw_abbess.first_complete_text: Her ring. She'd want it on the road.

tw_tiger_pelts.name: Striped Pelts
tw_tiger_pelts.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Striped Pelts. Bring Huntress Devi four striped tiger pelts.
tw_tiger_pelts.first_complete_text: Tigerhide sleeves. I made them from the first ones.

tw_saffronclaw.name: Saffronclaw
tw_saffronclaw.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Saffronclaw. Bring Huntress Devi Saffronclaw's pelt.
tw_saffronclaw.ready_text: Saffronclaw's pelt. Gold as they said.
tw_saffronclaw.complete_text: The old queen's gone. The bamboo's ours.
tw_saffronclaw.first_complete_text: A saffron mantle. Wear her colors.

tw_cobra_fangs.name: Antivenom
tw_cobra_fangs.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Antivenom. Bring Herbalist Ila four king cobra fangs.
tw_cobra_fangs.ready_text: Fangs. Careful how you hold them.
tw_cobra_fangs.complete_text: Enough antivenom for a month of pilgrims.
tw_cobra_fangs.first_complete_text: A snake-charmer's gloves. Nothing bites through them.

tw_beetle_shells.name: Lamp-Black
tw_beetle_shells.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Lamp-Black. Bring Herbalist Ila four road beetle shells.
tw_beetle_shells.ready_text: Shells! The shrines' lamps will thank you.
tw_beetle_shells.first_complete_text: A cap from the biggest of them. Harder than it looks.
